# Study and training loan indexation rates
## How we work out indexation
Indexation maintains the real value of the loan by adjusting it in line with changes to the Consumer Price Index (CPI) or Wage Price Index (WPI) – whichever is lower.

| Year | Indexation rate |
|-|-|
| 2026 | 2.8% |
| 2024 | 4% (previously 4.7%) |
| 2021 | 0.6% |
| 2020 | 1.8% |
| 2015 | 2.1% |

web.title: Loan increases and indexation - Study Assist, Australian Government
web.description:
## How is the indexation rate calculated?
The rate of indexation that is applied to your HELP debt changes each year as it is based on the lower of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) or Wage Price Index (WPI).
